reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday matcher in shared/schedules.ts and replaces every existing holidays.includes check with it.

duplication.why: The holiday-matching rule is defined once; the pre-existing 'isWeekend || holiday' composite remains repeated at four sites but the diff does not add copies.

placement.why: The matcher lives in shared/schedules.ts alongside the other date helpers and is imported by the server schedules app.

scope.why: Only the holiday membership checks and a test change.

maintainability.why: A small, clear helper; folding the weekend check into a single non-working-day predicate would have removed the remaining repetition.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday membership checks in shared/schedules.ts and server/schedules/app.ts now call isHoliday.
